excelImport.title: Register purchase from Excel
excelImport.atomicWarning: This operation writes stock movements, stock levels, cost, and prices. Each upload batch runs in one database transaction and cannot be undone. If you import multiple batches in a row, earlier batches remain applied if a later batch fails.
excelImport.fileUploadDropTitle: Drag your Excel file here or click this area
excelImport.parseBlocked: The file could not be parsed. Fix the issues below and try again.
excelImport.previewTitle: Preview: {{count}} rows will import · {{issues}} with errors · {{warnings}} omitted (warnings).
excelImport.noImportableRows: There are no rows ready to import. Fix the red errors or check the spreadsheet. Remember: on a row with several locations, a zero in one cell only skips that location; you still need at least one quantity greater than zero in a recognized column.
excelImport.rowErrorsTitle: Rows with issues (they will not import until fixed)
excelImport.rowErrorsHint: The row number matches Excel when you open the file (row 1 is the top of the sheet). Each card shows the Item column text and what to fix.
excelImport.variantNotFound: No active catalog variant uses this exact name. Compare the spelling with the variant name in your system.
excelImport.variantAmbiguous: More than one active variant shares this name. Names should be unique in the catalog (or use another identifier such as SKU when supported).
excelImport.variantUnresolved: This line could not be linked to a variant. Re-upload after fixing the item text.
excelImport.rowWarningsHint: Each card shows the exact Excel column header (e.g. "STORE - …" or "WAREHOUSE - …") where the quantity was zero or blank. If other columns on the same row have a positive quantity, those still import; this list is only rows where no recognized location had a quantity greater than zero.
excelImport.rowWarningZeroLocationsDetail: For this row, in {{locationList}}, the quantity is zero or blank. No purchase movement will be recorded for those locations.
excelImport.rowWarningOmittedFallback: No recognized location column has a quantity greater than zero on this row; no purchase movement or cost/price update will be recorded for this line.
excelImport.successSummary: Import finished. Product rows: {{rows}}. PURCHASE movements created: {{movements}}.
